poem.title: 鹿柴
poem.author: 王维
poem.text: 空山不见人，但闻人语响。返景入深林，复照青苔上。

Author: 王维

translation:
Deer Park

Empty hills—no one in sight,
only the sound of human voices.
Returning sunlight enters the deep forest
and falls again upon the green moss.
